All 30 issues are filed and verified on [scottdensmore/Cakebrew](https://github.com/scottdensmore/Cakebrew/issues) — **#67–#96**, labeled by type, priority, and effort (5 × P0, 20 × P1, 5 × P2).

- **Created 16 labels**: the ten type labels, `P0`/`P1`/`P2`, and `effort:small|medium|large`.

## Where I'd start

[#67 Fix Upgrade All Outdated](https://github.com/scottdensmore/Cakebrew/issues/67) — it's small, it's the app's headline action, and it's currently broken in a way that's easy to miss: your shell-injection fix (PR #58) changed argument passing from space-joined to positional `"$@"`, which made the long-standing `upgradeFormulae:@[@""]` hack at [BPInstallationWindowController.m:223](Cakebrew/Controllers/BPInstallationWindowController.m:223) start sending brew a real empty argv entry. Verified live. A regression test at the argv seam prevents it recurring, and it exposes the missing mock override that let it through untested.

Then [#68](https://github.com/scottdensmore/Cakebrew/issues/68) — it's the only P0 that can actually wedge the app, since the single-threaded pipe read in `BPTask` can deadlock on a chatty install with no Cancel to escape.

One pattern across the P0s worth naming: your XPC helper transport already handles streaming correctly (`availableData` + a split-UTF-8 hold-back buffer), while the direct `BPTask` path — the default for shipping builds — never got those fixes. #68 proposes sharing one decoder rather than maintaining two divergent implementations, and #16/#82 covers the mock gaps that let this class of bug through CI.

The raw audit data (64 verified findings, per-dimension) is at `scratchpad/backlog.json` if you want the detail behind any issue.
